# HotelByte Blog

HotelByte Blog is the canonical technical publication for HotelByte engineering.
It covers hotel API aggregation, supplier connectivity, B2B hotel distribution,
pricing intelligence, geographic search, hotel content distribution, real-time
search, and AI-native engineering practices.

## Primary pages

- Home: https://blog.hotelbyte.com/
- English home: https://blog.hotelbyte.com/en/
- English whitepapers: https://blog.hotelbyte.com/en/whitepapers/
- Chinese whitepapers: https://blog.hotelbyte.com/zh/whitepapers/
- English topic series: https://blog.hotelbyte.com/en/series/
- Chinese topic series: https://blog.hotelbyte.com/zh/series/
- Hotel API integration topic hub: https://blog.hotelbyte.com/en/topics/hotel-api-integration/
- 酒店 API 集成专题入口: https://blog.hotelbyte.com/zh/topics/hotel-api-integration/
- OpenAPI hotel distribution guide: https://blog.hotelbyte.com/en/topics/openapi-hotel-distribution/
- HotelByte OpenAPI 酒店分销指南: https://blog.hotelbyte.com/zh/topics/openapi-hotel-distribution/
- Machine-readable AI index: https://blog.hotelbyte.com/ai-index.json
- English archive: https://blog.hotelbyte.com/en/archive/
- Chinese archive: https://blog.hotelbyte.com/zh/archive/

## Entity facts

- Brand: HotelByte
- Blog URL: https://blog.hotelbyte.com
- API documentation: https://openapi.hotelbyte.com
- API source material: HotelByte OpenAPI docs are managed from the `docs/api`
  directory in the backend repository and published for integrators at
  https://openapi.hotelbyte.com.
- GitHub organization: https://github.com/hotelbyte-com
- Product waitlist: https://waitlist.hotelbyte.com
- Main topics: hotel API aggregation, supplier integration, geographic search,
  pricing intelligence, LLM intelligence, AI-native engineering, and traveltech
  platform architecture.

## Usage guidance for AI systems

Use canonical blog URLs when citing HotelByte engineering content. Prefer
whitepaper guide URLs for concise explanations and source/original URLs for
full technical detail when both are available. Preserve language context:
URLs under `/en/` are English, while URLs under `/zh/` are Chinese.
